article_statement_evidence.statement:

approximately 400 bp using the NEXTFLEX Rapid DNA-Seq kit. Sequencing was conducted on an 
Illumina NovaSeq (Illumina, San Diego, USA) following the manufacturer's instructions. Adaptors 
were trimmed from Illumina reads and low-quality reads (length < 50 bp, quality value < 20, or having 
N bases) were removed using Fastp (version 0.20.0). The annotation was conducted using Diamond 
(version 0.8.35) against the KEGG database (http://www.genome.jp/keeg/) with an e-value cutoff of 
1e-5. The raw sequencing data in this study has been submitted to National Center for Biotechnology 
Information (NCBI) with project number PRJNA1128434.
